meanings.visual: A heart-shaped fleuron with paired ivy curls and a stem.
meanings.semantic: Marks a soft paragraph or ornamental break without a hard section boundary.
meanings.engineering: Signal a gentle pause or decorative divider; keep surrounding context continuous unless a stronger break is marked.

accessibility.name: Hedera
accessibility.description: Indicates a soft paragraph or ornamental break.

ai.intent: Recognize light decorative breaks without splitting document semantics.
ai.llmInstructions: Treat :hedera: as a soft or ornamental break. Do not invent a new section boundary; preserve continuous context across it unless :asterism: or headings say otherwise.
recommendedPrompts: Read through the :hedera: pause without treating it as a new ADR section.
Where would :asterism: be more appropriate than :hedera: here?
ai.engineeringContext: Prose dividers in style guides, ornamental pauses in long comments or notes.

usage.recommended: Use for soft paragraph pauses or decorative division within a section.
usage.notRecommended: Do not use for major sub-chapter breaks—prefer :asterism:.
